title: status data (server to client), 1 Hz and on change

active_model.description: The model loaded on the DPU (R2-G); model.set releases it and loads the other one.

switching.description: True while model.set waits for the frame in flight, releases the old runner and loads the new one.

swap_ms.description: Duration of the last model swap in milliseconds, or null before the first one.

fps.description: Processed frames per second, or null.

errors.description: Codes of the conditions the process reports.

zoom.description: YOLOX centre-crop magnification before the letterbox (1.0 = whole frame).

zoom_center.description: Crop centre [x, y] as fractions of the (mirrored) frame.

gain.description: Manual V4L2 gain of the RGB camera.

exposure.description: exposure_time_absolute in 100 us units; calibration.set accepts 100 (1/100 s) or 200 (1/50 s).

saturation.description: V4L2 saturation of the RGB camera.

calibration.description: Live calibration applied now (debug panel): YOLOX zoom/centre and the camera gain, exposure and saturation; null before the pipeline knows it.
